summary_1line: Bharata mournfully sees the grass where Rama slept in exile and vows to live austerely until Rama returns to rule Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata stands beneath the Ingudi tree gazing at the flattened grass where Rama slept, with scattered golden particles from Sita’s ornaments glinting on the ground.
Bharata kneels beside the rough grassy bed, holding a thread of Sita’s silk scarf while his mothers look on in sorrow.
In grief and resolve, Bharata declares he will wear ascetic garb and sleep upon the earth in the forest until Rama returns.
